negative_prompt: watermark, text signature, logo in corner, artist name, copyright notice, blurry, low resolution, bad anatomy, 3D CGI plastic render, glossy plastic skin, smooth flat digital vector, photorealistic human skin, young person, bright neon lighting, deformed compass, extra fingers, outer decorative border, ornate frame, picture frame
reconstruction_priority: Tactile polymer clay skin texture with hand-etched wrinkles — AI models frequently hallucinate either hyper-smooth digital CGI plastic or real human porous skin instead of matte crafted clay.
Frizzy wool-felt hair and beard fiber volume — AI typically collapses physical stop-motion fiber grooms into uniform polygon hair cards.
Shallow macro depth of field on facial plane — AI often renders both the character and background with uniform edge sharpness.
Articulated clay hand holding the miniature brass compass — AI tends to fuse fingers into the metallic casing or distort circular geometry.
